_meta.name: On Food Stamps (SNAP)
_meta.unit: percent of US residents receiving SNAP, fiscal-year average
_meta.source: USDA Food and Nutrition Service, SNAP Annual Summary; population from BEA via FRED (POPTHM)
_meta.note: Average monthly SNAP (food stamp) participants in each federal fiscal year, divided by the calendar-year average resident population. Both numbers are published; the ratio is the only arithmetic. Participation rises in recessions and with eligibility expansions (2009 ARRA; pandemic emergency allotments 2020–2023).
_meta.method: snap-annualsummary xlsx column B (thousands) ÷ FRED POPTHM annual mean (thousands) × 100
